messages:
jamie: heads-up: I'm prepping a short docs patch to tighten SOC2 language around audit logs + retention. Goal: clear default wording, tenant-example, tiny JS SDK migration note, and an operator appendix. Can ppl quick review?

fran: happy to. what line are you planning to use for retention?

jamie: thinking: "By default, Redwood retains audit logs for 90 days. Extended retention is available via enterprise contract; Dedicated/Private deployments can configure retention per operator settings." Keeps it accurate but not absolute.

legal_noah: that reads safe. add: "Redwood segregates tenant audit data; cross-tenant access is not supported. Logs are encrypted at rest; Private deployments may be configured to use customer-managed keys (KMS)." Also note: customers should consider redaction for PII in prompt text.

jamie: added that. drafting a short tenant-scoped example for the audit-log section like this:
```json
{
  "name": "model.invoke",
  "tenant_id": "org_99",
  "data": {"prompt": "[REDACTED]"},
  "redacted_fields": ["prompt"],
  "ts": "2026-05-03T15:30:00Z"
}
```
Does that look implementable?

fran: yes. maybe call out explicitly that the SDK normalizes camelCase fields but wire JSON is snake_case. People trip over that.

jamie: good point. will add a one-liner about camelCase <-> snake_case. also need the SDK migration snippet; we renamed audit api: old `client.audit.log()` -> new `client.audit.emit()` and payload keys changed. Draft snippet:
```js
// OLD
await client.audit.log({ event: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'org_99', payload });
// NEW
await client.audit.emit({ name: 'model.invoke', tenantId: 'org_99', data: payload });
```
Note: wire JSON uses tenant_id and name.

docs-bot: lint: SOC2 docs - avoid absolutes like "never" or "always"; prefer conditional language. Flagged missing note about operator-only curl examples.

ops_kai: If you include a curl example, put it in an "Operator appendix" with a clear warning. Do not publish internal endpoints casually. Sample operator curl (appendix only):
```bash
# operator-only
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.example/v1/audit -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"model.invoke","tenant_id":"org_99","data":{}}'
```

legal_noah: one more: add a short sentence that retention and access controls are subject to contract and that customers should route legal requests via their account contact.

jamie: will add. plan: update docs page with new wording, include JSON tenant example and js migration snippet, append operator curl under an appendix with warning, and open PR. i'll tag legal_noah and ops_kai for review.

fran: small nit: include a one-line example showing `redacted_fields: ["prompt"]` in the JS snippet too so devs can copy-paste.

jamie: done. opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2529 (WIP). tagging reviewers. will update thread when merged. :+1:

ops_kai: I'll skim the appendix once it's up. thanks.

legal_noah: thanks — will give legal sign-off once PR includes the contract/escrow line.

jamie: appreciated. updates incoming.
